scope.source_inspection: Existing retained public originals and existing actual REA6.4.0 IR only. Literal discovery manifest is a worker-inspected subset inventory, not authoritative corpus total.

UI_observation_from_parent.evidence_type: Original UI read/query observation supplied by parent, not browser actions performed by worker. No company result records retained.
UI_observation_from_parent.limits: Header existence/order does not prove aggregation/tax/quantity formulas or blank-bucket behavior.

aggregate_not_null.status: actual generic validator found; current form attachment/options unknown
aggregate_not_null.source_contract: When options?.is_use falsy =>true. Otherwise empty data=>false. Collect nonempty values in condition_01..condition_05 using _.isEmpty(record); returns false only if aggregate_key.type===free AND no collected condition value. It does not explicitly require condition_01.prop_id or check sequential filling/duplicates.
aggregate_not_null.shape_limit: A nonempty condition object is counted even though this predicate does not inspect prop_id. Other configured validation/control/server logic may reject incomplete objects.

aggregate_special_regex.source_contract: For slots1..5 with truthy condition object, test prop_id against regexp objects returned from configured option names; any matched invalid pattern returnsfalse. This is a character/pattern check, not an explicit duplicate or middle-gap check.

current_duplicate_axes.source_limit: No explicit $$aggregate duplicate-prop or duplicate-semantic-axis predicate was found in the inspected consumers/validator definitions. Do not infer candidate exclusion or end-to-end acceptance from absence. Sorting-popup duplicate exclusion is a different feature.

current_empty_middle_axis.source_limit: aggregate_not_null alone permits a nonempty later slot while earlier slots empty; it has no adjacency check. getAggregateCondition filters empty values and keeps existing condition_NN keys; the called common.getAggregateConditionKeys implementation and current control/attribute/server validation are absent, so compaction/order/acceptance after gaps is not established.

separate_summary_type.status: available source, not interchangeable with current aggregate field
separate_summary_type.source_contract: summary_summary_not_null requires truthy condition_01.prop_id. summary_summary_verify_condition inspects raw prop_id of slots1..5 and rejects repeated truthy identical values; it does not check middle gaps or normalize case/trim. summary_summary_verify_target restricts repeat target length<=1 and requires target nonempty if first criterion selected.
separate_summary_type.datatype_boundary: Source error map distinguishes type.$$summary with summary_not_null/verify_target/verify_condition from type.$$aggregate with not_null/special_regex/graph. Current search DMC datatype and attached attributes/options are dynamically provided and not captured here.

axis_count.status: 4visible axes observed; no universal hard4limit proven
axis_count.source_contract: Generic aggregate validators loop slots1..5. Their existence neither proves a fifth visible axis nor changes the parent-observed four-slot current UI.

predicate_only_examples_by_reasoning_not.case: free, only condition_03 is a nonempty record, is_use=true
predicate_only_examples_by_reasoning_not.middle_gap: This predicate has no rejection; full current behavior unknown

predicate_only_examples_by_reasoning_not.separate_summary_first_and_duplicate_che: first present/unique pass those two checks only

axis_consumption.getAggregateCondition: Selects entries with nonempty value and keys matching /condition_\d{2}/g, retaining original keys; no explicit renumber/slot-gap rejection here. This helper belongs to a drilldown action path.
axis_consumption.free_summary_models: InventoryStatusCreateDMCResolver calls external common.getAggregateConditionKeys(aggregate), then creates summary1..N model ids and subtotal1..N reference types by returned list length/order. The helper implementation is missing, so do not infer axis-slot compaction or duplicate handling.
axis_consumption.classification: checkAggregate treats fixed+details_target.value=line as nonaggregate; free with sole selected prop_id matching summary_line also nonaggregate. This is mode classification, not group-sum arithmetic or validation.
axis_consumption.query: SelectInventoryStatusProgram delegates conditions/sorts/groups generation to common$DataModelModifierForSearchConditionProgram, sends query to /ec56/api/inventory/action/SelectInventorySearchStatusAction and returns response data/total/date. No backend query or aggregation executed by worker.

axis_semantics.meaning_status: Symbol mapping explicit; specific current report group expression/source field identity still dynamic.
Person-in-charge(employee) conversion naming explicit; no claim this is every employee field or current header/line data placement.
Project conversion mapping explicit; current report field/group expression dynamic.

mapping_consumer_boundary.source_contract: For each selected condition, map refer_type through summary_code_condition_map, resolve target search prop (optional item-meaning-id mapping first, otherwise by mapped refer_type), read clicked summary-row condition.prop_id plus comparison suffix. For $$multi_code with nonempty value.code, emits [value]; other types use separate date/default handling. Unknown mapping/search prop =>skip.
mapping_consumer_boundary.proves: These symbolic axes can become wh/pic/pjt search filters when drilling into an aggregate result.
mapping_consumer_boundary.does_not_prove: This is not backend GROUP BY implementation or current candidate renderer binding, employee permissions, null/blank bucket grouping, multi-axis nesting/ordering, warehouse subtotal/grand-total formulas.

unknowns: Current axis-picker duplicate exclusion and empty-middle-axis UI normalization/rejection remain unobserved and not source-bound.
Current aggregate datatype/options/validator attributes and common.getAggregateConditionKeys/condition modifier implementation are dynamically provided or missing.
Do not apply separate $$summary first-axis/duplicate rules to $$aggregate without binding evidence.
No formulas for qty/supply_amt/vat_amt/amt, rounding, warehouse code/name grouping, deleted/missing references or grand total were inferred from field names or five observed headers.
No current-original multi-axis Apply/query/save experiments performed by this worker.
